class.description: SplineTweenResource (`GeometryResource`) Multi-track spline tween asset storing an ordered list of `SplineTweenTrack` tracks, duration, loop mode, and Undo/Redo `commit_*` track authoring methods. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
